segments.text: She is the protagonist’s childhood friend, and until a year ago, they attended the same school in a small town.
When the protagonist moved away, their relationship turned into a long-distance one, though they hadn’t been officially dating before that.
In fact, it was the separation that spurred them both to take the initiative, and they finally became a couple.
Perhaps because she grew up in the countryside, she is innocent and demure. She is a girl who is completely devoted to the protagonist.
She gives her all to everything, and that includes sex as well. Although she’s shy, she’s willing to try all sorts of things.
After they were separated, they kept in touch constantly by phone and email, but during summer vacation, she comes to Tokyo all by herself because she wants to see him.
From Getchu

She’s a relative of the protagonist and is like a little sister to him. She’s very attached to the protagonist and looks forward to his visits every summer vacation. She’s the cute, clingy “little sister” type
However, when she found out he wouldn’t be coming this year, she ended up coming to his house to see him. She prefers the protagonist, an older, kind, and mature adult ,over boys her own age.

At school, she’s a member of the drama club. She has a promising future as a star, that you can see in her eyes. She fully immerses herself in her roles, and appears to drift into another world as she acts.
Using her woman’s intuition, she feels a sense of rivalry toward Chinatsu and tries various ways to catch the protagonist’s attention, but her efforts gradually escalate.
From Getchu
A former student of the protagonist’s father, a university professor, she is a private tutor who has come at the professor’s request to look after his son while he is away.
They live together for three weeks. She is a slender beauty and holds black belts in martial arts (karate, aikido, etc.).
Eager to impress the professor, she resolves to rigorously drill the protagonist during summer vacation to boost his grades.
Consequently, the unannounced visitor (Chinatsu) is nothing but a nuisance to her. Seeking to tear the two apart (?), she goes out of her way to interfere in various ways.
That said, she isn’t without her feminine side. In fact, she is currently caught up in an unrequited love affair...
From Getchu
The woman next door. A gentle woman overflowing with maternal instincts. The protagonist’s room is completely visible from her house, she’s fascinated by the protagonist (who has a youthful body).
Eventually, after watching the protagonist and Chinatsu having sex, she can’t stand it anymore and starts making advances using her sex appeal.
Although she’s in her prime and loves sex, her husband actually suffers from erectile dysfunction, leaving her sexually frustrated.
To spice up the relationship between the protagonist and Chinatsu, she gives them all sorts of advice and even gives them sex toys.
From Getchu
